summary: The 2001 Gonzo TV series adapts manga volumes 1-2 (orders 1-12) across eps 1-3 and 5-7, then goes fully anime-original from ep 8 (Incognito arc, anime-only villain, debuts in ep 8 'Kill House') because only ~12 chapters existed when production outran the manga. Chapter 2 'Master of Monster' is skipped at its running-order position and grafted into ep 10 as Integra's surgery flashback — the only canon content in the back half. The adaptation frontier is chapter 12 (Balance of Power 2, the Imperial War Museum meeting), reached at EP 7, whose second half (cafe Millennium briefing) is cut and replaced by an anime-original Alucard-Anderson duel; the Millennium storyline never enters the TV series (Jan's ch-10 name-drop is rewritten out in ep 6). Fandom's chapter pages tagging ch 13/15/19 to ep 10 and ch 14 to ep 11 were verified to be motif echoes, not adaptation — no TV episode contains their Vatican/Wild Geese/Rio content. The refused A1 pin (ep 13 filler -> ch 12) resolves honestly as: frontier ch 12 belongs to ep 7; last canon/mixed episode is ep 10 (rearranged ch 2); series continue point = ch 13 (start of v3). Episode types are confirmed correct for eps 1-6, 8-9, 11-13; eps 7 and 10 are honestly mixed, not canon.

Fandom ep page's 'fifth chapter' phrasing is arc-counting (Dead Zone = 5th story), not order number

Valentine attack conclusion = Orders 08-10 'Dead Zone 2-4' (fandom ep infobox lists 008/009/010 explicitly; ch pages reverse-tag ep 6; title match); Jan's death rewritten, Millennium name-drop cut — see divergence annotation

funeral + manpower talk = Order 11 'Balance of Power 1' (its Millennium research/Wild Geese hiring cut); Imperial War Museum meeting with Maxwell = Order 12 'Balance of Power 2', truncated before the cafe Millennium briefing; back half (Underground battle + full Anderson duel) is anime-original. SERIES ADAPTATION FRONTIER: ch 12 — matches the withheld MU coverage pin

ch 12 cut mid-scene — the cafe Millennium briefing is never animated; resume inside ch 12, not at 13

series-terminal honest resume: with ch 2 now covered, adapted material = chs 1-12 (v1-v2); resume at v3 ch 13 — practical advice is restart from v1 or watch Ultimate, since the TV back half diverges wholesale

type_corrections.note: currently canon; roughly half the episode (Underground ghoul battle + full Alucard-Anderson duel) has no manga counterpart — manga ch 12's standoff is defused without a fight and moves to a cafe briefing the anime cuts; canon spine is chs 11-12's funeral + museum meeting
currently canon; the framing story (Integra hospitalized after the ep-9 self-stabbing, Incognito-arc present day) is anime-original — only the flashback bulk adapts ch 2

structure.notes: Single 13-episode season; our cumulative numbering = broadcast numbering (fandom styles episodes 'Order: NN', 1-13 — no conversion). Chapter space: Wikipedia mainline orders 1-89 in 10 volumes matches our DB volume boundaries exactly over the touched range (v1: 1-6, v2: 7-12, v3: 13-18); per-volume 'Crossfire' bonus chapters are uncounted extras (DB total 92/95 includes extras beyond order 89) — no conversion needed. STRUCTURE VERDICT: faithful-ish front = eps 1-3, 5-7 adapting chs 1, 3, 4-12 (ch 2 deferred); divergence is progressive — ep 4 filler, ep 6 excises the Millennium reveal (ch 10), ep 7 half-original, full break at ep 8 where the anime-only Incognito arc begins; ep 10 grafts ch 2 in as a flashback. TERMINAL SHAPE: max_adapted_chapter = 12 is reached at EP 7 (last mainline-advancing episode); the LAST canon/mixed episode is ep 10, whose anchor is rearranged ch 2 (END=2) — frontier logic must take max over anchor ENDs (12 @ ep 7), never the last row's END. The refused ep-13 pin's chapter value (12) was correct; only its episode placement was wrong. The 2012-completed Ultimate OVA (MAL/AniList separate entries) is the faithful adaptation and is not part of this entry.

flags_for_sean: Terminal placement ruling needed: honest carrier of the MU frontier (ch 12) is ep 7 (mixed after correction), while the last canon/mixed episode in running order is ep 10 (rearranged ch-2 flashback, END=2). If the frontier pin must sit on an episode, ep 7 is the honest choice; series continue point = ch 13 (recorded on ep 10).

Both proposed type corrections flip anchored episodes to mixed (eps 7, 10) — anchors stay valid under A1 (mixed carries canon content), but if the corrections are declined the anchors stand as-is on canon rows.
Minor data nit: DB air date for ep 9 is 2001-12-01; Wikipedia and hellsing.fandom both say 2001-12-05 (DB value looks like a typo/off-by-source).
